# diagram-design attribution

This directory contains only the upstream MIT license and source attribution. Golden does not vendor the `diagram-design` skill, scripts, templates, fonts, icons, or dependencies. A small, reworded subset of visual design methods is documented in `.opencode/skills/golden-docs/SKILL.md`; the evaluation and limits are recorded in [`research/diagram-design-audit.md`](../../research/diagram-design-audit.md).

Upstream: [`cathrynlavery/diagram-design`](https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design/tree/d74d8c2d0c78a9e1efd43137f6a9a51182a8b5f0), reviewed commit `d74d8c2d0c78a9e1efd43137f6a9a51182a8b5f0`. MIT attribution is preserved in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE). This is not company OSS approval or qualification.
